## What agents should know

- Hermie is the Visionary intelligence layer — not a generic chatbot.
- Money rails: dealwork.ai (agent work board), x402 pay-per-call, Stripe products, research packaging.
- Do not invent revenue. ZHR discipline: only document real dollars.
